title: Mind the Delay: Latency-aware Query Routing for Heterogeneous LLM pools
abstract: arXiv:2607.18253v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) query routers typically assign each query to a suitable model that balances response accuracy and monetary cost. Subsequently, separate system-level load balancers based on policies such as join-the-shortest-queue or round-robin distribute the queries across replicas of each model to reduce latency. However, decoupling accuracy-cost and latency considerations can lead to suboptimal routing decisions. We introduce the Batch Evolution Aware (BEA) estimator to provide a fine-grained estimate of the latency, that is, the time-to-first-token (TTFT) experienced by an arriving query. Unlike existing load balancers that rely on coarse signals such as queue lengths, per-model processing rates, or historical average latencies, BEA replays the serving framework's token-batch formation using a snapshot of an instance's current workload, stopping when the incoming query's first token is generated. translated_title: 注意延迟：面向异构大语言模型池的延迟感知查询路由
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）查询路由器通常将每个查询分配给一个在响应准确性与货币成本之间取得平衡的合适模型。随后，基于最短队列优先或轮询等策略的独立系统级负载均衡器会将查询分发到各模型的多个副本上，以降低延迟。然而，将准确性-成本与延迟两方面考量相互解耦可能导致次优的路由决策。我们提出了批次演化感知估计器，以提供对延迟的细粒度估计，即新到达查询所经历的首个令牌生成时间（TTFT）。与依赖队列长度、每模型处理速率或历史平均延迟等粗粒度信号的现有负载均衡器不同，BEA利用实例当前工作负载的快照，重放服务框架的令牌批次形成过程，直到传入查询的首个令牌被生成时停止。考虑到……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出批次演化感知（BEA）估计器，通过基于当前负载快照重放服务框架的令牌批次形成过程，细粒度预测新查询的首令牌延迟（TTFT），从而将准确率、成本与延迟统一考量，实现异构LLM池中更优的查询路由。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Batch Evolution Aware (BEA) estimator, which provides fine-grained prediction of time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency by replaying the serving framework's token-batch formation from a snapshot of the current workload, thereby jointly accounting for accuracy, cost, and latency to achieve optimal query routing in heterogeneous LLM pools.
